title: </sub>  Close the evidence cohort before permitting effect claims
text:
</sub>  Close the evidence cohort before permitting effect claims

Because reviewed-but-unadjudicated pull requests neither count nor block this label, an operator can promote the evidence by adjudicating any ten favorable or easy cases while leaving unfavorable sweep-enabled cases unresolved. The matched-control requirements do not remove that cohort-selection bias, so the resulting recall, variance, and cost claims can misrepresent the accumulated evidence. Define the cohort or sampling window before adjudication and require every eligible pull request in it to reach a terminal adjudication before permitting `real_pr_measured` claims.
